text:
Mira: dropping a compact mock for the rollout timeline — noticed two things: when you scrub quickly tooltips flash out of order, and the focus ring in dense rows is nearly invisible. figma.com/...

Theo: Repro'd. Tooltip queueing is the issue; rapid mousemove enqueues multiple show timers. Also the compact focus is 1px and low contrast.

Sofia: Proposal: debounce tooltip show at 130ms and cancel pending shows on new events. For assistive tech, use a single announcer region: role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" and update only its innerText with full context (version + percent + one-line change).

Kendrick: Visual fix: switch to a 3px solid outline with outline-offset for compact density and add a subtle dashed border when a canary is paused to avoid confusing it with disabled. CSS example: `.chip--pause { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; border-style: dashed; }`

Mira: Good. What about rollback flow copy? Currently long CTA duplicates header. Suggest short button "Rollback" + confirmation details: "Rollback to v5.0.2 — creates a new rollout at 100%" and an Undo toast for 6s.

Theo: Agree on copy. Also SR should get assertive announcement on rollback success: "Rollback complete 1 v5.0.2 now serving 100%". Use polite for scrubs and assertive for critical changes.

Sofia: I'll implement the announcer and debounce in frontend branch. I'll ensure we snapshot document.activeElement before opening detail drawer and restore on close to keep keyboard flow.

Kendrick: I'll update the Figma frames for compact + paused styles and add focus screenshots for VoiceOver. Also will draft the rollback toast design (6s, keyboard-focusable Undo).

a11y-bot: Automated check: found duplicate live regions previously. After consolidating to a single live region and fixing contrast for focus outline, the major issues should be resolved. Reminder: include axe-e2e and VoiceOver/TalkBack runs on the PR.

Mira: Thanks everyone. Priority = patch for tooltip debounce + focus + announcer. Undo toast and copy polish next sprint. I'll add these to the QA checklist and tag eng-frontend.
